list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Sodium/potassium/piperazinium salt of the four-shell lanthanum polyoxotungstate cluster

source_locations.location: Main text, paragraph describing crystallographic structure of 1-La
Main text, Figures 1–2 and surrounding structural description
Supporting Information, Section S1 Experimental section, “Syntheses of 1-Ln” (1-La)

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete four-shell assembly: an inner La3+ ion sits inside a crown-shaped {W6O28} ring; this is enclosed by an elliptic {La26O108(OH)4(H2O)22} cluster, which is in turn encapsulated by ten dilacunary [GeW10O38]12− polyanions arranged as an elongated square bipyramid. The La26 cluster bridges the outer polyanions, yielding the overall matryoshka-like La-containing polyoxotungstate.

synthesis.procedure: Mix the polyoxotungstate precursor, La(NO3)3·6H2O, and pip in 2 mL distilled water. Stir for 1 h, then seal in a 25 mL Teflon-lined autoclave and heat at 140 °C for 72 h. Cool to room temperature to obtain colorless crystals of 1-La.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: After cooling to room temperature, colorless crystals were obtained.

title: Four-Shell Polyoxometalates Featuring High-Nuclearity Ln26 Clusters: Structural Transformations of Nanoclusters into Frameworks Triggered by Transition-Metal Ions
